column1: # Pronunciations the bundled CMU dictionary gets wrong for THIS app, and words
# it does not carry at all. Word (lowercase) TAB ARPABET, merged over cmudict
# at load — see KokoroPhonemizer.load.
# Two kinds of entry, and nothing else belongs here:
#  1. NAMES AND WORDS THE DICTIONARY LACKS. Without an entry these fall through
#     to RuleG2p, which guesses from spelling. That is fine for a stranger's
#     name and wrong for a word the app says every session: "Tuki" came out
#     "Taki" on the device.
#  2. HETERONYMS WHERE THE DICTIONARY'S ONE ENTRY IS THE OTHER SENSE. The
#     bundled dictionary keeps a single pronunciation per word, and for a few
#     it kept the one this app does not use. There is no part-of-speech
#     tagging in the front end, so the entry has to match how the CORPUS uses
#     the word; where a corpus is split, the majority wins and the minority
#     lines are listed in the comment so the cost is visible.
# ScriptS/tests: PronunciationCoverageTest asserts every word the shipped
# content speaks resolves from the dictionary or from here, so a new theme
# cannot quietly reintroduce a guess.
# --- the tutor's own name, said in the first sentence of every session ------
tuki
column2: T UW1 K IY0

column2: Y OW0 AA1 V
